Google began rolling out Gemini 3.8 Live and Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking for voice: Google says Live can process visual inputs and make background tool/API calls, while Extended Thinking can narrate its progress as it reasons.
In a Sep. 15 reply to a user’s post about thinking effort and usage limits, OpenAI’s Tibo Sottiaux warned that “it consumes things faster,” but gave no rate or reset time.
